_note: Targets the step scripts read. Changing a target is a reviewed commit on main; the run records this file's git commit in out/latest.json.

identities._note: Stand-in owner addresses are fleet-held test accounts, accepted only on the stage for steps 1-3 and the update proof. Any other owner matching a fleet pattern fails.

1.title: A stand-in company installs HappyToHelp through its Business on the stage

2.title: That company attaches its own addresses

3.title: That company imports legacy history through the product

P2.title: One update taken by a click on an installed product, with no fleet hands between click and Live

event_log._note: Event types are matched by these patterns. Platform main 86030a5 writes only update.available for updates; the click and Live types must match what the platform writes once it records them.
